Job Summary
PT Multi Farmindo Jaya is seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Production Further Process Coordinator. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing, coordinating, and optimizing the daily operations of our further processing production lines. You will ensure that all processed poultry and food products meet the company’s strict standards for quality, safety, and efficiency while driving continuous improvement in the production workflow.

Job Responsibilities
* Supervise and coordinate the daily operations of the further processing department to meet production targets and schedules.
* Monitor product quality, food safety, and hygiene standards in compliance with HACCP, GMP, and Halal regulations.
* Coordinate with the quality control and assurance teams to address and resolve any production anomalies or quality deviations.
* Manage and allocate manpower, raw materials, and machinery efficiently to minimize waste and maximize yield.
* Prepare, maintain, and analyze daily production reports, inventory logs, and performance metrics.
* Collaborate with maintenance teams to ensure all processing equipment is properly calibrated, cleaned, and maintained.
* Implement and enforce strict occupational health and safety (OHS) protocols on the production floor.

Job Qualifications
* Bachelor’s Degree in Food Technology, Chemical Engineering, Animal Husbandry, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in production coordination or supervisory roles, preferably within the poultry processing or food manufacturing industry.
* Strong knowledge of food safety management systems, including HACCP, GMP, and Halal certification standards.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills to effectively manage production teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen eye for detail.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and familiarity with ERP or production management software is highly advantageous.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to flexible shift schedules as required.
